messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: ZC35nNOLDsAOJeoMgLai3A

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "ZC35nNOLDsAOJeoMgLai3A"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",

    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls a map of the ruined royal city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept hilltop overlook at dusk; an ink-stained coated mapmaker with a brass compass spreads a vellum map showing broken spires and a distant bridge.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of obvious traps ahead.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up of an oil lamp held aloft, a single glowing eye inside the flame casting orange light across Mara's worried face.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox sniffs the wind near the castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with blue glass eyes and a key-wind tail crouches before tall iron castle gates draped with torn royal banners.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver steps out of a cracked shop window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges from a fractured storefront pane, coat reflecting broken neon-blue city lights and falling glass shards.

scenes.caption: The team meets in a collapsed plaza fountain.
scenes.visual_description: A dry stone fountain in a moonlit plaza; the mapmaker, the clockwork fox, the oracle lamp, and the glass-helmeted rescuer gather around a chalk-drawn route.

scenes.caption: A sleeping official blocks the records office door.
scenes.visual_description: A plump bureaucrat slumped against a doorway, ledger book under his head as a pillow, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, drool on official seals.

scenes.caption: Mara lifts the keyring without waking him.
scenes.visual_description: The cartographer leans over the snoring official, two fingers pinching a brass keyring; the tin fox watches from the shadow of a filing cabinet.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols march past the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: From a low gutter view: clanking metal greaves stomp past in the foreground while a leaning black tower glows with purple cracks behind.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp ignores the dragon rumor.
scenes.visual_description: A graffiti-scrawled wall depicting a scaly winged beast; the lamp's eye narrows skeptically while Mara tugs her coat tighter.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver slips through a tall mirror.
scenes.visual_description: A gilded ballroom mirror ripples like water; the helmeted rescuer half-submerged in its surface, coat trailing silver reflections.

scenes.caption: Inside the mirror, a magic door pulses.
scenes.visual_description: A corridor of floating mirror fragments; at its end, an arched door inscribed with rotating runes glows turquoise.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox solves the rune lock with a precise tap.
scenes.visual_description: Close shot of the clockwork fox's metal paw pressing a rune; sparks ricochet off the door, runes spinning into alignment.

scenes.caption: They find the captive in a banner-draped cell.
scenes.visual_description: A small stone cell hung with faded royal banners; the sleeping tax collector — yes, the same one — is curled on a cot, paperwork still stuck to him.

scenes.caption: The rescue target was the dozing official all along.
scenes.visual_description: Mara raises an eyebrow at the lamp; the lamp's eye flares in apology; the tax collector snores serenely beneath a torn crest.

scenes.caption: Frightened townspeople scatter as alarms ring.
scenes.visual_description: Distant silhouettes flee down a smoky avenue under clanging bell towers; the team carries the limp official between them, the fox running ahead.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols converge on the river road.
scenes.visual_description: Torchlight columns advance from three streets, helmets and pikes glinting; the lamp's beam picks a narrow alley exit toward the water.

scenes.caption: They sprint across the cracked stone bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A long arched bridge over black water at dawn, half its parapet collapsed; four figures and one bundled sleeper race toward the far bank as embers fall.

scenes.caption: Safe on the far shore, the official sleeps on.
scenes.visual_description: Pink dawn over reed marshes; Mara folds her map, the fox winds its own tail, the lamp dims to a candle-glow, and the tax collector snores against a milestone.
